name: Naomi Gloria
source:
One of the Gloria family's daughters. She is the same age as Sicile, but acts much more irresponsibly.

She's quite cynical and makes sure to let others hear her strange viewpoints. Sake helps her loosen her tongue, so she drinks it all day long.
